Ashley (Sales): Heads-up: Lumina Bank sent back the SIG and wants evidence per-question. Deadline end of week. can we triage and package? :calendar:
Raj (Security): I can take KMS/key custody, network segmentation, and IAM controls. where are we storing artifacts today?
Olivia (Eng): I'll grab runtime isolation screenshots, TLS cert chains, and pod security policies. Upload to the shared SIG folder unless you want copies inline.
Ashley (Sales): Put everything in /shared/sigs/lumina_bank/ and paste a copy here. We need one-line cover notes for each item.
Chris (Solutions): Note: POC environment details sent yesterday, they want egress/flow logs and a sample alert from our monitoring. I have annotated screenshots.
Raj (Security): For SIG Q13 (KMS rotation) we need rotation-policy.pdf, rotation-audit.csv, and a short signed statement about custody. Follow filename convention: lumina_q13_kms-rotation-YYYYMMDD.zip
Olivia (Eng): Uploaded a zip with the cert chain and runtime screenshots.
Olivia (Eng): ```
S3: s3://redwood-sec-artifacts/lumina/q13/lumina_q13_kms-rotation-20240512.zip
Contents: rotation-policy.pdf, rotation-audit.csv, rotation-audit.log
```
Raj (Security): Good. Also include HSM vendor attestation or SOC statement. I can redact internal IPs and customer names.
sec-bot: Reminder: SIG schema v2 in effect. Include control IDs in filenames, e.g., Q13_control-KMS_v2. Docs: https://internal.redwood/sec/sig-v2
Ashley (Sales): Lumina also asked about EU data residency for their tenants. quick wording so I can respond?
Raj (Security): We support region pinning for Dedicated/Private and hosted routing to eu-west for hosted customers. Attach data-residency.pdf and the related policy excerpt.
Olivia (Eng): I'll add a sanitized runbook for spinning a private pod plus a `kubectl` snippet.
Olivia (Eng): ```
# sanitized snippet
kubectl apply -f redwood-poc-deployment.yaml --namespace=lumi-poc
```
Chris (Solutions): On pricing: they asked Dedicated vs Hosted for ~100k tokens/day. I gave a ballpark but we need finance sign-off for a POC discount.
Ashley (Sales): @Finance please advise on approving a one-month 50% POC discount. if no response by EOD I'll escalate.
Raj (Security): Q21 (cert revocation): do we have OCSP/CRL proof? I can draft a PKI ops note referencing CRL publication times.
Olivia (Eng): I added flow logs and OCSP screenshots to the shared folder; redacted private ranges.
Ashley (Sales): Plan: build one zip per SIG question, each with a 1-line cover note and control-id in filename. I'll assemble tonight.
Chris (Solutions): I'll review the cover notes for technical accuracy before sign-off.
Raj (Security): I'll perform final security review on the questions I own. ping me once zips are ready.
Ashley (Sales): Timeline: triage today, assemble artifacts tomorrow AM, internal sign-offs by noon, deliver to Lumina Friday EOD. blockers?
Raj (Security): None from security besides potential redactions. @Olivia please mark any logs with private ranges for removal.
Olivia (Eng): Doing that now. uploading redacted copies.
sec-bot: Audit: user Olivia uploaded 7 files to /shared/sigs/lumina_bank at 2024-05-12T14:22:10Z
Ashley (Sales): Thanks team — I'll post the final ZIP here and paste the outbound email to Lumina for review. :thumbsup:
